title: Ingest filed rendered tool calls and their results as conversation
notes: Claude Code exports render each tool_use as an assistant message `tool: <Name>` and its
tool_result as the next unmarked user message; 759,708 calls and 692,868 results, 78% of
raw records and 56% of their text, were indexed as prose. `ToolRound` now pairs each
rendered call with the results owed to it (parallel calls counted, assistant prose closes
the round) and both are rejected under their own tally rules.
result: on a 3,000-conversation sample, 43,834 calls and 40,717 results rejected; 25 rejected results read by hand were all tool output. On the 85-question set, dropping them loses no answer and search R@10 moves 0.27 to 0.28. Synthesis jobs key on the archive's `contentSha256`, so no conversation is re-synthesized.
evidence: `uv run pytest` 589 passed, 2 skipped; ruff and mypy clean; five new cases in `tests/test_ingest.py`.
